name: Veras
source:
Strengths: knowledgeable, patient, has a calming effect on people
Weaknesses: cold temperatures, poor spatial orientation, too altruistic

Veras is a blind traveler usually seen with Illran, He speaks and acts maturely, but is naturally down to earth.
He's generous and kind to everyone, but tends to favor Illran over others.

He believes in doing the right thing, even at the cost of himself, and tends to disapprove of the way Illran acts, sometimes. 

He holds many secrets.

[Edited from the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/the-divine-speaker-a-fantasy-bl-yaoi-gay-visual-no]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
